answer: Assign each earning key one numbered hive with a 30 POA hold. Enrollment files a comb photo and a pollen baseline from yarrow grown at that stand. At solar zenith every stand is sampled in one hour; if the chromatogram drifts from the enrolled yarrow mix, the hold burns. A colony cannot be on two stands in that hour, and a shifted comb misses the baseline, so each added fake needs another living colony. Design figures only: $45 to found a hive, $12 monthly rent. 150 clones run $6,750 plus $1,800 monthly and 4,500 POA held, even along the dune reserve.
